description.narrative: Emergency humanitarian assistance, resilience building and support to local capacities and rights-based approaches in crisis affected communities and HHs in Takhar and Badakhshan provinces of Afghanistan, and refugees in Tajikistan. Outcome 1: Vulnerable, crisis-affected communities are provided with life-saving assistance to meet critical needs in fragile and protracted contexts, thereby reducing the impact of negative coping strategies. Outcome 2: Vulnerable and crisis-affected communities are supported to become more resilient and recover better through restored household food security and livelihoods, and through safe, inclusive and equitable access to improved and sustainable productive infrastructure Outcome 3: Enhanced capacity of a range of local partners (Community level authorities, CBOs, CSOs and NGOs, both formal and informal) to serve as active ‘agents of change’ and to lead the process of relief and recovery together with crisis-affected communities
